_readme: Game tuning. Times are in milliseconds. Edit freely; restart the app to apply.

customer._readDelay: How long a customer takes to read your message, by persona 'read' speed.
customer._patience: Waiting this long for your reply makes them chase you; leaveAfterNudgeMs later they leave. The waiting timer turns yellow at warnAfterMs.
customer._maxTurns: Customer replies after the question before they give up.
customer._meter: Impatience meter (0-100, shown in the chat header). Each customer reply adds 'perReply' by persona patience; pushing back on a wrong/unclear answer adds 'pushback'. At 100 they leave. VIPs tolerate 1-3 pushbacks calmly (vipGrace), then each pushback adds vipPushback.

pay._formula: Pay = Base(rank) x VIP x (score/100) x (serviceMultBase + serviceMultPerStar*stars) x length x time x bonuses + tip

mentor._autoHints: Mentor messages you a hint when a customer has pushed back hintAfterPushbacks times in one chat (at most maxHintsPerChat per chat).
